python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''def require_holding_guard(layout: Layout) -> None:
    state = systemctl("is-active", layout.service)
    if state.stdout.strip() not in {"inactive", "failed"}:
        fail(f"{layout.service} must be inactive before staging; got {state.stdout.strip() or state.returncode}")
    if not HOLDING_GUARD.is_file() or not HOLDING_DROPIN.is_file():
        fail("temporary volatile-state holding guard is not installed")
    show = systemctl("show", layout.service, "-p", "ExecCondition", "-p", "ExecStopPost", "-p", "DropInPaths")
    text = show.stdout
    if str(HOLDING_DROPIN) not in text or str(HOLDING_GUARD) not in text:
        fail("effective systemd unit does not contain the holding ExecCondition")
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ExecStopPost=") and line != "ExecStopPost=":
            fail("effective ExecStopPost is still destructive; refusing migration")
'''
new = '''def require_holding_guard(layout: Layout) -> None:
    """Require an effective fail-closed fence before durable staging.

    Phase 10 uses the raw volatile-state holding condition. Phase 20 intentionally
    resets ExecCondition and replaces it with the semantic cutover condition.
    Before CUTOVER.json exists, that later condition is itself an admissible
    staging fence only when it proves the expected volatile-state block. This
    preserves fail-closed behavior without requiring an ExecCondition that the
    phase-20 drop-in has deliberately replaced.
    """
    state = systemctl("is-active", layout.service)
    if state.stdout.strip() not in {"inactive", "failed"}:
        fail(f"{layout.service} must be inactive before staging; got {state.stdout.strip() or state.returncode}")
    if not HOLDING_GUARD.is_file() or not HOLDING_DROPIN.is_file():
        fail("temporary volatile-state holding guard is not installed")
    show = systemctl("show", layout.service, "-p", "ExecCondition", "-p", "ExecStopPost", "-p", "DropInPaths")
    text = show.stdout
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("ExecStopPost=") and line != "ExecStopPost=":
            fail("effective ExecStopPost is still destructive; refusing migration")

    holding_declared = str(HOLDING_DROPIN) in text
    holding_effective = holding_declared and str(HOLDING_GUARD) in text
    cutover_effective = str(CUTOVER_DROPIN) in text and str(CUTOVER_TOOL) in text
    if not holding_declared:
        fail("temporary volatile-state holding drop-in is not effective")
    if holding_effective:
        return
    if not CUTOVER_TOOL.is_file() or not CUTOVER_DROPIN.is_file() or not cutover_effective:
        fail("effective systemd unit has no admitted fail-closed staging ExecCondition")

    ok, reason = condition(layout)
    if ok:
        fail("semantic cutover condition is already start-permissive before staging: " + reason)
    if not reason.startswith("volatile_semantic_state_without_verified_cutover:"):
        fail("semantic cutover condition did not prove the expected pre-stage block: " + reason)
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('require_holding_guard source block not found exactly')
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
s = s.replace('execution requires the VM inactive AND the temporary stop/start holding guard\n  effective, so the source cannot disappear while being staged.', 'execution requires the VM inactive AND an admitted fail-closed stop/start staging\n  fence effective, so the source cannot disappear while being staged.', 1)
p.write_text(s)

t = Path('werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover_selbsttest.py')
x = t.read_text()
x = x.replace('import tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path', 'import tempfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom types import SimpleNamespace', 1)
needle = '''    ok, reason = m.condition(layout)
    assert not ok and "volatile_semantic_state" in reason

    dry = m.stage(layout, execute=False, require_systemd=False)
'''
insert = '''    ok, reason = m.condition(layout)
    assert not ok and "volatile_semantic_state" in reason

    # Phase 20 resets the phase-10 ExecCondition. The semantic cutover
    # condition is an admissible staging fence only while it independently
    # proves that start is still blocked before the manifest exists.
    original_systemctl = m.systemctl
    original_paths = (m.HOLDING_GUARD, m.HOLDING_DROPIN, m.CUTOVER_TOOL, m.CUTOVER_DROPIN)
    fake_holding = root / "holding.sh"
    fake_holding_dropin = root / "10-volatile-state-guard.conf"
    fake_cutover = root / "semantic-state-cutover.py"
    fake_cutover_dropin = root / "20-semantic-state-cutover.conf"
    for path in (fake_holding, fake_holding_dropin, fake_cutover, fake_cutover_dropin):
        path.write_text("fake\n")
    m.HOLDING_GUARD = fake_holding
    m.HOLDING_DROPIN = fake_holding_dropin
    m.CUTOVER_TOOL = fake_cutover
    m.CUTOVER_DROPIN = fake_cutover_dropin

    def fake_systemctl(*args):
        if args and args[0] == "is-active":
            return SimpleNamespace(stdout="inactive\n", stderr="", returncode=3)
        return SimpleNamespace(
            stdout=(
                f"ExecCondition={{ path={fake_cutover} ; }}\n"
                "ExecStopPost=\n"
                f"DropInPaths={fake_holding_dropin} {fake_cutover_dropin}\n"
            ),
            stderr="",
            returncode=0,
        )

    m.systemctl = fake_systemctl
    m.require_holding_guard(layout)
    m.systemctl = original_systemctl
    m.HOLDING_GUARD, m.HOLDING_DROPIN, m.CUTOVER_TOOL, m.CUTOVER_DROPIN = original_paths

    dry = m.stage(layout, execute=False, require_systemd=False)
'''
if needle not in x:
    raise SystemExit('selftest insertion point not found')
x = x.replace(needle, insert, 1)
needle2 = '''    ok, reason = m.condition(layout)
    assert ok and reason == "durable_cutover_verified"

    # Before the first cutover start, durable drift must fail closed because the
'''
insert2 = '''    ok, reason = m.condition(layout)
    assert ok and reason == "durable_cutover_verified"

    # Once the manifest is valid, the same phase-20 condition becomes
    # start-permissive. It must no longer authorize re-staging/overwrite.
    m.HOLDING_GUARD = fake_holding
    m.HOLDING_DROPIN = fake_holding_dropin
    m.CUTOVER_TOOL = fake_cutover
    m.CUTOVER_DROPIN = fake_cutover_dropin
    m.systemctl = fake_systemctl
    try:
        m.require_holding_guard(layout)
    except m.CutoverError as exc:
        assert "already start-permissive" in str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("start-permissive cutover condition incorrectly authorized re-staging")
    finally:
        m.systemctl = original_systemctl
        m.HOLDING_GUARD, m.HOLDING_DROPIN, m.CUTOVER_TOOL, m.CUTOVER_DROPIN = original_paths

    # Before the first cutover start, durable drift must fail closed because the
'''
if needle2 not in x:
    raise SystemExit('selftest second insertion point not found')
x = x.replace(needle2, insert2, 1)
t.write_text(x)
PY
python3 -m py_compile werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover.py werkzeug/semantic-state-cutover_selbsttest.py
